title: Captain Mark's Dolphin Cruise
specs: Family-owned and operated for over 30 years

services.name: Hilton Head Dolphin Tour
services.desc: Captain Mark’s Hilton Head dolphin tour is perfect for families, couples, groups, and solo travelers of all ages. Enjoy a relaxing cruise, narrated by Hilton Head’s most experienced captain. You’ll see the coastal landscape and wildlife that can only be found on a Hilton Head dolphin tour. You’ll also learn a bit about the history of Hilton Head Island and life on our beautiful island. Enjoy a relaxing Hilton Head dolphin tour with Captain Mark, the most experienced Captain on Hilton Head. This calm-water cruise highlights our coastal wildlife, nature, and history. Watch the sun set over Hilton Head Island as you relax on this cruise, watching bottlenose dolphins and seabirds, and taking in

includes: Narrated cruise with information about Hilton Head and dolphins
blurb: Guests explore Hilton Head's waterways on calm-water cruises to watch Atlantic bottlenose dolphins, seabirds, and other wildlife. Tours include sightseeing past private homes, yachts, Harbour Town lighthouse, and Daufuskie Island. A crabbing adventure is also offered where guests can practice crabbing in the marshes.
highlights: Family-owned and operated for over 30 years

quotes.text: This is a very good value as the cruise lasted about 2 hours...Captain Mark was very informative and told me lots of things that I did not know about the area and dolphins. The weather and the scenery were great. This was the second time I have taken this trip and I would absolutely do it again.

Recently took my fifth cruise with Capt Marks Dolphin Watch....I enjoy this informative and delightful cruise so much! The trip is narrated with so many facts about HHI, I am constantly amazed. The ship is very big, not fast, not scary, no motion sickness. Just a really enjoyable trip.

Captain Mark and Thomas were friendly, the boat was clean, and we learned things that we hadn't known before--thanks to Captain Mark's excellent and informative narration of all things HHI. We will do this boat trip again, next time with our kids.

It was just wonderful...Captain Mark was most informative about the history of the island, and the development of Hilton Head as a community. And yes, we did see several pods of dolphin, and Captain Mark gave us plenty of information.

We took a sunset cruise and it could not be more happy with the experience! It was absolutely gorgeous and we saw tons of dolphins. Captain Mark is very knowledgeable. It was truly a pleasant evening!
